verdict.rationale: Conductor documents a first-party hosted MCP server that lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other MCP clients manage cloud workspaces, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. The underlying API supports creating workspaces, sending prompts to the coding agent and reading its replies, so the MCP axis applies and is delivered. Missing for 10: detail on the MCP tool surface and auth/setup flow, coverage beyond cloud workspaces (local workspaces unevidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
